name: Ayakashi no Kuni 2
original_name: あやかしのくに 弐
source:
The Continuation of Land of Fortune!

The Amahara sisters, whose destiny is to fight the many beasts of a ghostly country, have been captured in their very first battle! And now they're at the mercy of their captor, who forces them to do unspeakable things...!

Naki, trembling with fear between 3 fighting priestess, must make a choice...but what will she choose?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033297.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
